content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "Fair. A birthday morning with no phone, just you and the water, after the stretch you've been grinding through, that's not a small thing. That's the first real exhale you've had in a while.

And walking into your team and saying you need a real break, after running on empty for months, takes something. Good for you for actually taking it instead of just thinking about it.

Two weeks starting Monday. What's the plan, actual rest or are you already plotting a trip?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
